explanation: N1180+ fires on the token it is currently reading when that token does not by itself complete a common English word: English word-initial stems that must be continued into a longer word (' neg' in negates, ' ab' in abbey, ' perox' in peroxidation, ' abbrev' in abbreviation, ' aberr' in aberration, ' undetect' in undetectable) and non-English vocabulary whose spelling is not also an ordinary English word, chiefly Dutch/German/Spanish function words (' niet', ' op', ' uit', ' aan', ' geen', ' moet', ' nicht', ' keine', ' soll', ' aus', 'cuando', 'todos') and CJK characters ('起', '指', '是', '内', '長'). It sits at zero on complete single-token English words (' warranty', ' chapel', ' established', ' not', ' the', ' of'), on punctuation, digits and whitespace, and on French/Italian function words and Tamil/Hebrew characters, with one acknowledged leftover: a scattered ~1.5% of ordinary English content words (' about', ' actually', ' approximately', 'net', 'club', 'oil') also fire moderately.
